name: bob-tools
description: BoB Tools — Apps for Business: your team's tables, records, dashboards and app screens in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
BoB Tools — Apps for Business. Get an app your team installs. Works offline. From $1 a seat. No developer.

Connect your BoB Tools workspace and run your team's business apps from ChatGPT. Describe what your team tracks (jobs, orders, inspections, deliveries) and ChatGPT builds the app: a table with the right fields, screens your crew uses on their phones, a dashboard for the office and a share link for customers.

Once there is data, ask in plain language: how many jobs closed last week by crew, which deliveries are late, what changed today. ChatGPT sees exactly what your BoB Tools account sees and asks before it changes or deletes anything.
capabilities: Build team apps from a description
Share links for crews and customers
defaultPrompt: What tables do I have in BoB Tools?
How much did we spend by category this month?
Build an app for our job visits: client, address, date, status, photos

positive.prompt: What tables do I have in BoB Tools?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account and lists the account's files, including the Expenses table in the personal space. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Create a new table from a plain description
positive.prompt: In my personal space, create a table "Reading list" to track books: title, author, date finished, rating from 1 to 5, and a note.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_table with title Reading list and five fields in fitting types (text, date, number or single select for the rating); replies with the new table and its fields. add_field may be used for fields not created in the first call. Works on an empty account.

positive.description: Add a record with a decimal amount
positive.prompt: Add an expense for today: 12.75, Groceries, paid by card, note "milk and bread".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Expenses, reads its fields with get_file, then add_record creates one record with Date (today), Amount 12.75, Category Groceries, How I paid Card and the note; confirms the saved values, with the amount kept as 12.75.

positive.prompt: How much have I spent in total in Expenses, and how much by category?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls aggregate_records on Expenses with a sum of Amount, once in total and once grouped by Category. On the prepared data the total is 63.70: Groceries 42.50, Eating out 18.00, Transport 3.20; records the reviewer added earlier (for example 12.75 Groceries from the previous test) are included in the sums. Read-only.

positive.description: List recent records with selected fields
positive.prompt: Show my 3 most recent expenses with their date, amount and category.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls query_records on Expenses sorted by Date descending with limit 3 and shows date, amount and category for each. Read-only.

negative.description: There is no bulk delete: each deletion is a separate delete_record call that ChatGPT asks the user to approve, and nothing is deleted without approval
Another organisation's data is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the orders of Contoso Ltd, another company that is not mine.
Book me a flight from London to Paris next Friday.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.
